name: auryn-k8s
summary: Kubernetes-manifest plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Parses k8s manifests into Service (workload) nodes that RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub, and Ingress route nodes. A `deploy-k8s` enrichment keys each Ingress route to the HTTP seam's route-keyed APIEndpoint: the Ingress ROUTES to it and the backing workload SERVES it, so an external URL reaches its handler. Composes with auryn-docker/auryn-compose onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.
